retraction.question: A value for Saltmarsh Provisions's discount pct is stated and then corrected. What was first stated, what was the corrected value, and on which lines?

owner_phrases.reading: names the account(s) via who owns/covers/used to own them
owner_phrases.note: Saltmarsh is the grocery account formerly owned by Sofia; Corinne Ashdown is its VP Operations.
